description: Upgrade plan to migrate project to Java 25

tasks.reason: Java 25 is the latest LTS version. Upgrading ensures access to the latest language features, performance improvements, and long-term support.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade JDK to version 25. Update build configuration (pom.xml or build.gradle) to target Java 25. Ensure all dependencies are compatible with Java 25. Note: Spring Boot 4.x is the only compatible Spring Boot version with Java 25 — if the project uses Spring Boot 3.x or earlier, a Spring Boot upgrade may also be required.
tasks.summary: Successfully upgraded the project from Java 21 to Java 25. Updated pom.xml java.version to 25, and updated Dockerfile build and runtime stages to use eclipse-temurin:25 images. Spring Boot 4.0.1 was already present and compatible. Build passed with BUILD SUCCESS.
